# CANDIDATE: INTRADAY_VIX_MEAN_REVERSION_SPIKE

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Intraday spikes in VIX above its short-term EMA often precede a short-term mean-reversion in SPY, especially when price pulls back to VWAP with a confirming candle. The strategy captures this edge by entering opposite the VIX spike direction after a VWAP retest and engulfing candle confirmation, with defined stop and target rules.

## Mechanism

Compute the 20-period EMA of VIX on the 1‑minute chart. When VIX > 1.5 × its EMA and SPY price retraces to within 0.2% of VWAP within the next 5 minutes, look for a bullish engulfing (for short VIX spike) or bearish engulfing (for long VIX spike) candle on the 1‑minute timeframe; enter opposite the VIX spike direction (short when VIX spikes and candle is bullish engulfing, long when VIX spikes and candle is bearish engulfing). Exit shape: Initial stop at the opposite side of the engulfing candle’s high/low; target at 1× ATR or at the next VWAP standard deviation band (1σ). Regime hint: Works best when intraday VIX is elevated (>20) but not in extreme panic (>35); avoid during the first 15 minutes after open when VIX is naturally noisy.
